AskDismissed.description:
A person dismisses an ask of another runner, with `priory dismiss RUNNER:ASK` or its endpoint.
Only that runner applies it, with the checks of a local dismiss.

ask.description: The ask's id on that runner.

revision.description: The question revision the person read.

runner.description: The runner whose ask it dismisses.

submission.description: The dismiss's own message id, which the runner's `priory.ask.applied` names.

id.description: A UUIDv5 of the message's name, so a retried publish keeps its id.

links.description: GitHub and Linear events carry one link to the event's page.
